part.text:
I couldn't get to Settings or Help & About. The simulator tooling here can take screenshots and open URLs, but it has no way to send taps or swipes, so I can't navigate the app's menus.

What I tried:
- **Screenshot:** The app is on the "All chats" screen. The avatar "A" at the top-left should open the menu that leads to Settings, but I couldn't tap it.
- **Deep link:** I ran `xcrun simctl openurl … "element://settings"`. iOS showed a system prompt, "Open in 'Element Classic'?", with Cancel and Open buttons. I can't press either button, so that prompt is still on screen and covering the app. I don't know whether Element supports a settings deep link, so this may not have helped even if the prompt were accepted.

To finish the task, someone needs to either tap "Open" on the prompt (or "Cancel" to dismiss it), then tap the "A" avatar at the top-left, then open Settings and select Help & About. Alternatively, I can continue if a tap-capable tool becomes available.
